sources.name: User-supplied floor-plan seed images
sources.notes: Only import images that the user owns or is authorised to use. Weak masks must be reviewed before production training.

sources.name: Dataset of 2500 synthetic single-family floor plans T0-T4
sources.notes: The dataset provides matching black-and-white and room-colour plans. Preserve attribution in trained-model documentation.

sources.name: Floor Plans 500
sources.download_method: Export COCO instance segmentation/object detection, then use --source coco
sources.notes: Contains 402 images and door, window and zone classes. An API key may be required for programmatic export.

sources.name: pseudo-floor-plan-12k
sources.notes: The dataset card exposes 12,000 rows with plan, wall, colour and footprint images but does not declare a licence. Do not use for a commercial model until the owner confirms terms.

sources.name: FloorPlanCAD
sources.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 for annotations; drawing copyright not owned by dataset authors
sources.download_method: Use FiftyOne or the project download and convert to COCO locally
sources.notes: Keep this source in a research-only experiment. It must not be mixed into a commercial model checkpoint.

sources.name: Modified Swiss Dwellings (MSD)
sources.license: verify Kaggle dataset terms before use
sources.download_method: Download from the Kaggle link in the MSD repository, then use --source vector-json or a custom adapter
sources.notes: The repository states that code and data are open, but the downloaded dataset licence must be recorded in the workspace before training.

sources.name: ResPlan
sources.license: paper states permissive open-source release; verify release package licence
sources.download_method: Import the published JSON/vector release with --source vector-json when the official package is available
sources.notes: The paper describes 17,000 vector and graph plans including irregular rooms, but the exact release licence file must be captured before commercial training.

sources.name: Floor_Plan_LoRA
sources.download_method: Optional offline Diffusers augmentation; not used by the detector runtime
sources.notes: This is a generative Stable Diffusion LoRA, not a geometry detector. Generated samples must be validated before inclusion.

sources.name: FloorPlanVisionAIAdaptor
sources.notes: The model card notes limitations on unconventional layouts and does not provide a traceable training-data licence. It is not bundled.

sources.name: RasterScan recognition service
sources.download_method: Configure a private endpoint or vendor Docker image separately
sources.notes: The public Space forwards images to a backend API and does not expose the recognition implementation. No proprietary backend code is copied into this repository.
